items.title: CONSENT CALENDAR

Approve Modification No. 1 to Job Order Contract No. JOC-100, HVAC Energy Efficiency (C-20 License), San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and Alameda Counties, with Mesa Energy Systems, Inc., to increase the contract duration by three years, for a total contract duration of five years, with no change to the contract amount, to provide additional time for facility and asset improvements

Award Contract No. WW-790, Evans Ave. and Mariposa St. Outfalls Improvements, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Pullman SST, Inc., in the amount of $2,576,348, with a duration of 379 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and one month), to rehabilitate the Evans Avenue and Mariposa St. Outfalls, in the City and County of San Francisco. This action constitutes the Approval Action for the Project for the purposes of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), pursuant to San Francisco Administrative Code section 31.04(h). The Planning Department has determined that the Project is exempt from the CEQA. The Commission will rely on that determination to make its decision SFPUC SEPTEMBER 9, 2025 MINUTES Page 3 of 7 on this action

Award Contract No. HH-1017, Warnerville Substation Rehabilitation – Phase 2, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Big Valley Electric, in the amount $6,695,000 and with a duration of 551 consecutive calendar days (approximately one year and six months), to replace four high voltage 230 kilovolts oil circuit breakers, associated switches, current voltage transformers, relays, surge arrestors, an overhead conductor, and a disconnect switch in the south yard of Warnerville Substation located in Oakdale, Stanislaus County

Award Job Order Contract No. JOC-113, Electrical (C-10 License) Construction, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, and Alameda Counties, in the amount not-to- exceed $5,000,000, with a guaranteed minimum task order opportunity amount of $50,000, and a duration of four years, to the responsible bidder that submitted the lowest responsive bid, Liffey Electric, Inc., to perform C-10 licensed electrical construction work on San Francisco Public Utilities Commission systems and operations around the Bay Area

items.title: Approve the Draft San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Cross-Connection Control Plan and Program Manual
items.text: Approve the Draft San Francisco Public Utilities Commission Cross-Connection Control Plan and Program Manual, which documents SFPUC compliance with the California State Water Resources Control Board Cross-Connection Control Policy Handbook: Standards and Principles for California’s Public Water Systems, and provides guidance regarding the requirements of the Cross-Connection Control Program; and authorize the General Manager to submit the Cross-Connection Control Plan and Program Manual to the State Water Resources Control Board and to make conforming revisions as needed.
